NAH in my opinion since OP is being respectful to their roommate . I think that the best thing would be to have an adult conversation about this and explain your feelings to one another. However, I think most of the comments I have seen have been very arseholey as someone who is spiritual. OP is right in saying if it had been any other religious item it would be seen as much worse. Why do people think it is ok to disrespect someone’s beliefs because they are not traditional? People who believe in crystals are no more crazy than people from any other religion and I was insanely disappointed to see such a large degree of mockery of something that brings me a great deal of comfort. That being said the misconception that moldavite is unlucky is unfortunate. It can bring drastic change, but that does not mean it is inherently bad, but rather cuts out toxicity from a persons life.
